# qrcode-generator

Version: 2.0.4, tag `js2.0.4`.

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/tree/js2.0.4/js

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified `js/dist/qrcode.js` from that release.
SHA-256: `79ec86f82856005b1c887905cfccfcfbec3821ca61c7fd5a952faa5f778f791c`.

License: MIT, included in `qrcode.LICENSE`.
